results.title: Jarq: Translate, shorten, fix or rewrite any text near your cursor | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hey Product Hunt 👋  
  
I'm Birzhan, a designer and solo indie developer from Kazakhstan.  
  
Jarq comes from the Kazakh word «жарқ» — a flash of light. That's the feeling I wanted: you select text, press a hotkey, and it's done. No switching to a chat tab, no copy-paste loop.  
  
What it does, right at your cursor in any Mac app:  
⚡ Translate a selection between any two of 13 languages  
✂️ Shorten, fix or rewrite text in place  
🎙️ Dictate (⌥`) — speak in one language, get clean, punctuated text in another  
  
Why another dictation app? Wispr Flow and Superwhisper are great at dictation. Jarq is built around the text actions — and translation is the core, not an add-on. If you write in a language that isn't your first one, this is for you. [...] Jarq

Pricing: free for 5 actions a day, forever. Pro is $4.99/mo, $39/yr or $200 one-time payment (lifetime), and everyone gets a 14-day Pro trial — no card, no account. Requires macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon.

# Rewrite, shorten, or restyle text with AI

Slides AI can rewrite the contents of a text block while preserving its structure and formatting. It works with blocks that combine headings, paragraphs, lists, and inline formatting, making it useful for refining a complete section of copy at once.

For broader requests that involve slides, layouts, research, or several kinds of content, work with Slides Agent instead.

## Open Edit with AI

Select or hover over a text block in the editor. The AI button appears near the lower-right corner of the block.

Click the AI button, or press `⌘ ⇧ I` on macOS or `Ctrl ⇧ I` on Windows and Linux, to open Edit with AI.

## Choose an editing action [...] The AI menu shows your current AI credit usage. Each request uses AI credits, and you cannot create another suggestion after reaching your available limit until credits renew or more are added.

To translate an entire presentation into a separate, editable copy, use presentation translation instead.
